title: Exceptions Registry, week-one minimal schema (registries/exceptions.yaml)
description: Section 54.5 Phase-1 completion check: 'expiry, owner, deactivation trigger present'. Section 54.5 requires the week-one minimal validator and the full Phase G2 validator (schemas/registry/exceptions.registry.v1.schema.json, L1-601) to read one schema and not two, so this schema is written as a strict subset -- every property this schema requires is also required by the full schema -- that L1-601's schema extends, never replaces. additionalProperties is left open at both levels so the full schema is free to close it without this one becoming a second, competing schema.
